title: Alveolar ridge preservation in defect sockets in the maxillary aesthetic zone followed by single -tooth bone level tapered implants with immediate provisionalization: a 1-year prospective case series
authors: Meijndert CM, Raghoebar GM, Vissink A, Meijer HJA. Int J Implant Dent. 2021 Feb;7(1):18. doi: 10.1186/s40729-021-00292-4.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Bone level tapered implants with immediate provisionalization perform well after alveolar ridge preservation in the maxillary aesthetic zone, according to implant stability, clinical, radiographic, aesthetic and patient-centred outcomes” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
